name: Thavala Vadai
steps: Rinse both rices and all four dals; soak together in the measured water until grains can be crushed but are not mushy.
Drain thoroughly and grind in batches with green chili and ginger to a coarse gritty mixture, not a smooth batter.
Fold in grated coconut, torn curry leaves and salt; press a little batter together to check it holds shape.
Shape small thick discs with damp hands and lower them gently into medium-hot oil in uncrowded batches.
Fry slowly until the centers cook and the outsides turn deep golden and crisp; drain and serve with coconut chutney.
tips: The coarse mixture of rice and several dals is essential; a smooth paste loses thavala vadai’s bite.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
